Finding: Low member activity is associated with higher churn
Recommended Action: Identify low-activity members and offer engagement or follow-up programs

Finding: Short contracts have higher observed churn
Recommended Action: Provide stronger engagement and retention support for short-term members

Finding: Churned members have shorter recorded lifetimes
Recommended Action: Focus early-stage members on onboarding and continued engagement

Finding: Members without group visits have higher observed churn
Recommended Action: Promote group sessions and community-based activities

Finding: Members without friend promotion have higher observed churn
Recommended Action: Encourage referral and friend-based membership programs

Finding: Members not near the gym have higher observed churn
Recommended Action: Consider targeted engagement for members who face greater location barriers
